mechanism_narrative: The current level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is inversely related to S&P 500 forward returns: lower FEDFUNDS levels predict positive returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns are not significantly higher than the market average (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeds 4.0%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in < 40% of triggered instances despite the FEDFUNDS > 4.0% condition, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The joint condition of a rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 295) signals an aggressive monetary tightening cycle that leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises > 0.2pp in 3 months AND CPIAUCSL > 295
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in < 40% of triggered instances despite the joint condition, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The current level of non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) is positively correlated with S&P 500 forward returns: higher employment levels predict positive returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than the market average (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1400.0 thousand units, it signals a weakening housing market that leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in < 40% of triggered instances despite HOUST < 1400.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in < 40% of triggered instances despite INDPRO < 105.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-unemployment regime (UNRATE > 4.0%), the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) becomes a positive predictor of S&P 500 returns: lower FEDFUNDS predicts positive returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in < 40% of instances when UNRATE > 4.0% and FEDFUNDS is low, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
